title: LiveClipper 2026.7.15.2
notes:
Signed Runtime V3 incremental update from 2026.7.15.1 to 2026.7.15.2.

- Fix settings persistence and activation reliability.
- Add multi-industry category support, mix source-group management, and video thumbnails.
- Add selectable duration tolerance to Smart Cut and Mix Cut.
- Treat sub-second duration overflow as a warning within the technical margin.
- Continue rendering after source-quota repair is exhausted, and continue batch processing after one group fails.
- Bundle and verify the fixed WebView2 runtime and ffmpeg/ffprobe tools.
- Keep launcher 1.1.0 and updater 1.3.0 unchanged.
